outcome_rules.if: Sustained low-energy gap spanning at least two adjacent local periods plus release/resumption is identified
outcome_rules.then: Code full-stop-compatible under the explicitly adapted corpus rubric; contextual/prosodic explanations remain possible.

outcome_rules.if: Irregular voicing occurs without a clear sustained closure
outcome_rules.then: Code incomplete/irregular-compatible or indeterminate; do not eliminate the source's glottal target merely because full silence is absent.

outcome_rules.if: Target and controls match the profile's [ʔ]-marked versus nonmarked roles in both performances while melodic contours differ
outcome_rules.then: This supports a factorized reading-role/performance description for these exposed modern tokens; it does not recover ancient origin or a universal glyph sound.

outcome_rules.if: Reading roles change with condition or alignment/measurement is equivocal
outcome_rules.then: Record a performance/source-prescription discrepancy or unresolved observation; preserve alternatives and check context/decoder before new source-reading changes.

observation.discriminates: Source-qualified phonetic-role stability versus melody-dependent or indeterminate realization in this modern pair. Does not distinguish all ancient-language hypotheses.
